The '''E-500 heavy sonic needler''' was a type of [[sonic pistol]]. The weapon was available during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]], during which both sides made use of the weapon. On the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], the [[Merchant/Legends|vendor]] [[Jorelle]] sold the weapon to individuals affiliated with the Republic, whilst on the planet [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]] the vendor [[Boibole]] sold it to Imperial aligned individuals. Both vendors sold the weapon for 14 planetary commendations, with its value in [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] being 405 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]]. The pistol was [[Color/Legends|bronze]] and silver in color and could be modified in various ways including the replacement of its [[Crystal/Legends|color crystal]] or its barrel.<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
The E-500 heavy sonic needler first appeared in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', an [[Star Wars video games|MMORPG]] released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]]. The weapons can be purchased by players in both of the games factions, but only members of the [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] or [[Bounty hunter/Legends|Bounty hunter]] class can use it.
